purpose: Test whether a small fixed relevance discriminant combining existing coarse cosine and cross-encoder logit can reject unrelated queries without adding a large generative verifier. Prior792 rectangular policies were limited to coarse minima null/.34; this is a distinct train-only method, not a claim that their RED results changed.

inputs.scope: Use only fixed60 short documents and248 train/calibration query records for runtime replay. Fit coefficients/scalers and select threshold using train only. Exclude check and every acceptance fixture. Neither old development split is independent evidence. No new inference.

candidatePool.selection: All complete structured-ID eligibility before globalK4; cutK before strong exemptions and cosine admission; never refill. Preserve source-authenticated same-field strong evidence. Every weak lexical field remains independent required work without a coarse cutoff.
candidatePool.pairs: Deduplicate exact query/document/original window identity across semantic and weak roles. The fixed corpus has one original field<=96 per document and <=1 lexical hit/query; assert this bound. Use only existing SCORED logits and full finite normalized384 vectors. Missing pairs are unknown and retain original denominators.

fit.trainingRows: Only runtime-required pairs from train queries of kind positive or ood. Label1 iff a positive query's relevant IDs contain this pair document; all other pairs from these kinds label0. Exclude missing-field/number diagnostics and entity mismatches from fitting. Strong exempt fields are not fitted. No document/topic IDs or vocabulary features.
fit.scaling: Population mean/standard deviation per feature on these train pairs only; zero variance uses scale1. Include unscaled intercept.
fit.loss: Class-balanced logistic cross-entropy: each class total weight.5, each pair within a class equal weight; add.01/2 times squared non-intercept standardized coefficients. No alternate feature or regularization grid.
fit.optimizer: Deterministic double-precision damped Newton, zero initialization, max100 iterations, maximum absolute gradient tolerance1e-10, Armijo1e-4 backtracking by halves through2^-20. Fail closed if linear solve, finite arithmetic or convergence fails. Optimization is numerical solving, not hyperparameter selection.
fit.score: Use learned pre-sigmoid linear discriminant for admission. It is a development relevance score, not a calibrated answerability probability.

threshold.positiveBoundary: Require fixed runtime pool to meet train language recall floors before selection; take minimum discriminant over relevant required pairs for train semantic positives reachable in this pool. Strong positives stay exempt. All reachable semantic positives must remain accepted.
threshold.negativeBoundary: For each original query language bucket separately (ScriptHan including mixed; English-only otherwise), take train pureOOD queries and their maximum required-pair discriminant. Queries with no required pair are negativeInfinity. Any strong-exempt OOD already consumes its false-positive allowance. Let allowance=floor(.05*original bucket query count)-strongExemptOodCount. If negative, RED. Sort remaining query maxima descending and take value at zero-based allowance as that bucket boundary (missing index means negativeInfinity). Use the maximum bucket boundary.
threshold.selection: If finite positiveBoundary is strictly above negativeBoundary, select their midpoint; if boundary is negativeInfinity select positiveBoundary. Otherwise RED_NO_TRAIN_MARGIN with no selected threshold. No fallback score. Calibration must not alter coefficients, scaling or threshold. Preserve all failed attempts and checks.
threshold.reporting: Report train and calibration coverage, each positive direction, exact/correction, pureOOD original language denominators, entity mismatch and missing-fact diagnostics separately, real prescribed pair counts, and unknown worst-case upper bounds. Keep original lexical/coarse RRF ordering after admission; no score-based reranking by discriminant.

qualification.development: Both train/cal: Chinese Recall@5>=.90, English Recall@5>=.90, both cross-language directions>=.85, overall MRR>=.75, each-language pureOOD FPR upper bound<=.05, exact-ID preservation and complete coverage. A failed boundary or calibration is RED; do not relax or fit on it.
qualification.resources: Only a small numeric head is added to two existing model roles. No claim of size/RAM benefit without actual self-contained artifacts and measurement. Their tokenizer JSON vocab/normalizer/pretokenizer/postprocessor match, while truncation/padding/config differ; sharing tokenizer needs exact role-specific parity before deployment. Pruned-head/graph equivalence is not assumed for this cross-encoder.
qualification.fullScope: Fresh independent full-language quality, actual guarded consumers including search/recovery/explicit memory,1000-fragment latency, lifecycle, provenance and packages remain required. automatic:null and default/version/gates unchanged.
